plugins.name: vibeguard
plugins.description: Security auditor and hardener for vibe-coded projects. 170+ vulnerability checks across 24 categories including injection, XSS, auth bypass, IDOR, Supabase RLS, prompt injection, exposed secrets, rate limiting, CORS, auth provider misconfigs (NextAuth, Clerk, Auth.js), and vibe-coding antipatterns.

skills.name: audit
skills.description: Scan a project for security vulnerabilities. Use whenever: the user asks to check, audit, scan, or review security; mentions vulnerabilities like XSS, injection, CSRF, IDOR, or prompt injection; asks about rate limiting, auth issues, exposed secrets, leaked data, or missing headers; mentions Supabase RLS, Firebase rules, or BaaS security; says 'is my app secure', 'security review', or 'fix vulnerabilities'; or when the project is vibe-coded, cursor-built, or AI-generated. Produces a findings table — does NOT auto-fix anything.
skills.description_zh: 扫描项目安全风险，涵盖XSS、注入、CSRF、IDOR、提示注入、限流认证、秘密泄漏、头部及Supabase RLS/Firebase规则，输出发现表，不自动修复。

skills.name: fix
skills.description: Fix security vulnerabilities found by /vibeguard:audit. Must be invoked manually — will never run automatically. Accepts arguments: 'all', 'critical', 'critical high', or specific issue numbers like '1,3,7'. Always run /vibeguard:audit first.
headings: 1. Show the vulnerable code (2-3 lines of context)
2. Apply the fix with a comment
skills.description_zh: 手动修复vibeguard审计发现，须先审计，可选择全部、critical、critical high或指定问题编号，不自动运行。

skills.name: harden
skills.description: Proactively harden a project's security beyond fixing known issues. Adds security middleware, headers, input validation, .env.example, lint rules, and strips console.logs. Must be invoked manually. Run /vibeguard:audit first to understand the project.
headings: Before Doing Anything: Present the Plan
skills.description_zh: 手动开展主动安全加固，先审计理解项目，再添加安全中间件、头部、输入校验、.env.example和lint并移除console.log。

headings: VibeGuard — Security Auditor for Vibe-Coded Projects
